HediffDef.label: commoner
HediffDef.description: This person belongs to the commoner caste: a free member of the colony who has accepted a lower station.\n\nCommoners expect less from life, but they can't do certain elite work, their skills only grow so far, and they can't hold ideoligion roles or royal titles.

HediffDef.label: offered commoner status
HediffDef.description: This prisoner has been offered a place in the colony as a commoner. Since less is asked of them, their resistance falls faster, and they'll join as a commoner when recruited.

li.label: extremely low commoner expectations
li.description: I'm a commoner in a destitute colony. I expect almost nothing.

li.label: very low commoner expectations
li.description: I'm a commoner in a poor colony. I expect very little.

li.label: low commoner expectations
li.description: I'm a commoner in a colony of modest means. I expect little.

li.label: moderate commoner expectations
li.description: I'm a commoner. A roof, a meal and honest work are enough for me.

li.label: high commoner expectations
li.description: I'm a commoner in a wealthy colony. I expect a decent life, but not luxury.

li.label: sky-high commoner expectations
li.description: I'm a commoner in a very rich colony. I expect to live well, but I know my place.

li.label: extremely low soldier expectations
li.description: I'm a soldier in a destitute colony. A dry bunk and a full magazine are all I ask.

li.label: very low soldier expectations
li.description: I'm a soldier in a poor colony. I've slept in worse places.

li.label: low soldier expectations
li.description: I'm a soldier in a colony of modest means. It's better than the field.

li.label: moderate soldier expectations
li.description: I'm a soldier. A roof, a meal and something worth defending are enough for me.

li.label: high soldier expectations
li.description: I'm a soldier in a wealthy colony. I expect decent quarters, but not luxury.

li.label: sky-high soldier expectations
li.description: I'm a soldier in a very rich colony. Plenty worth defending here.

li.label: lost my station
li.description: I've been moved down a caste. I used to stand higher in this colony.

li.label: fell far in station
li.description: I've been brought down two castes. Everyone saw it happen.

li.label: cast down from my station
li.description: I've lost everything I was. From the top of this colony to the bottom.

li.label: made a full citizen
li.description: I'm a full citizen of this colony now. My work was noticed.

li.label: certified as an artisan
li.description: My craft has been recognized. I'm a certified artisan.

li.label: raised to the nobility
li.description: I've been raised to the nobility. This colony is mine to guide now.

li.label: certified as a scholar
li.description: My learning has been recognized. I'm a certified scholar.

li.label: enlisted as a soldier
li.description: I've taken up arms for this colony. I'm no commoner now; I'm a soldier.

li.label: raised from slavery
li.description: I'm not a slave anymore. I'm a commoner now, and my life is my own again.

SlaveInteractionModeDef.label: elevate to commoner
SlaveInteractionModeDef.description: A warden will free this slave and welcome them into the colony as a commoner.
